description.narrative: "The objectives of the Trust Funds are to assist developing countries in achieving inclusive and sustainable economic growth and to foster broader dialogue on economic development issues through (a) financing global and regional programs (b) generation and transfer of development knowledge, including Korea's development experience (c) project identification, pre-appraisal and appraisal, and (d) co-financing country investments and associated technical assistance activities."
